_doc: Expert-block tiling for the fused MoE kernel.
Add an entry per measured bin: {"arch": "mp_31", "mp_count": 56, "values": {...}, "note": "<how it was measured>"}.
An entry with "mp_count": null applies to the whole arch; "arch": null is the last resort.
Values are checked against MoeTactic in tactics/__init__.py: an unknown knob is an error, not a silently ignored field.
Only entries with measured evidence belong here - a guessed tiling is worse than the generic path, because it looks tuned.

tactics.note: generic starting tactic; not tuned for any MUSA bin yet
